evidence: PC17 connected to SW17 Fa0/18 has no link light or network access.
SW17 show interfaces status indicates Fa0/18 is disabled.
SW17 show running-config interface Fa0/18 contains shutdown.
root_cause: SW17 Fa0/18 is administratively shut down in its interface configuration.
verification: Run show interfaces status on SW17 and confirm Fa0/18 shows connected/up.
Confirm PC17 now has a link light and network access.
fix_steps: Access SW17 and enter global configuration mode.
Issue the 'no shutdown' command to bring the port up.
Verify the interface status using show interfaces status.
